    Name the bond, not only the element

    The class behind the name

    The 2025 reveal called this class Spiritmaster. The March 2026 English update used Elementalist and listed Command: Proxy.

    Sources: NCSOFT class reveal, June 2025 · March 2026 class update. Historical context; skill names and availability may differ by region or update.

    This page keeps Spiritmaster for players using that name. Pacts, companions and shared purpose offer a different naming direction from the Sorcerer’s explosive elemental imagery.

    The keeper of a pact

    Caller, bond and pact describe a relationship. Starwisp feels like a gentle companion; Voidbond suggests an uneasy agreement. Decide how your character relates to spirits before choosing the tone.

    The liminal traveler

    Soft openings such as Eth- and Sel- work well with open endings. Ethora can sound like someone between worlds without borrowing the exact name of a famous lore character.

    Six handpicked Spiritmaster names

    Original suggestions selected for their sound and theme. These are creative interpretations, not official names or availability claims. Click a name to copy it, or ☆ to save it.

    • Between worlds

      An airy opening and open ending support an otherworldly mood.

    • Gentle binder

      A smooth personal name that leaves the companion in the spotlight.

    • Small companion

      A delicate spirit image with a luminous setting.

    • Uneasy pact

      The relationship matters as much as the dark element.

    • Patient summoner

      A clear calling motif with a calm celestial rhythm.

    • Weathered promise

      A compact alias for a bond forged through hardship.

    Try a Spiritmaster naming direction

    Ethereal personal name →Elyos · Fantasy · up to 9 letters · starts EthKeeper of a dark pact →Asmodian · Epic compound · up to 12 letters

    A final sound check: Imagine the name beside an elemental companion. It should sound like the one who calls or keeps the bond, unless you intentionally want the character to resemble a spirit.

    Frequently Asked Questions

    What is a good Spiritmaster name?

    Ethora and Selaen offer soft personal names. Starwisp suggests a gentle companion, while Voidbond and Ashpact emphasize the agreement between a summoner and a spirit.

    What does the Spiritmaster do in Aion 2?

    It is a summoner and controller class that commands spirits to pressure enemies and provide crowd control and utility.

    How do I use the Spiritmaster name generator?

    The class is already set to Spiritmaster. Choose Elyos or Asmodian, pick a gender and tone, then hit Generate. Click any name to copy it, or ☆ to save it to your shortlist.
